notes.notes:
[h2]Sorry, I'm a Nice Player[/h2]
As the number of players has increased, uncivilized behavior has emerged, particularly verbal abuse, which is extremely offensive.
So, just now, we added a reporting system to the game. You can press [b]"F10"[/b] to report recent players. Reports will be reviewed, and reported players will be subject to varying degrees of game restrictions.

[*]Optimized the game save mechanism, reducing the save frequency to reduce corrupted files due to power outages and other issues.
[*]Exiting the game using Alt+F4 now displays a confirmation panel; click Confirm to exit the game.

notes.title: The Solution to the Gray Screen Bug
notes.notes:
[h2]Issues[/h2]
Just now, we received feedback from some players that their 3D graphics turned completely gray after entering the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/ac5de6a520d856bef8a353730be305f2c381ef62.png[/img]
After investigation, we found that this bug is caused by the latest AMD graphics driver update on August 4th, which affected the Vulkan graphics rendering module. We are actively working on this bug report.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png[/img]
[h2]Solution[/h2]
Currently, we offer two solutions:
[*] Roll back your AMD graphics driver to a version prior to the August 4th update.
[*] Add [b]--rendering-driver opengl3[/b] to the launch options to run the game using OpenGL 3. (Some graphics quality will differ with OpenGL 3 compared to Vulkan.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png[/img]
Feel free to report bugs to us at wavebox66@gmail.com!

notes.title: Nine-ball Roulette Now Supports Masse Shot
notes.notes:
[h2]Add a spin, and an angle[/h2]
Just now, we made some updates to the game. We introduced the masse shot method to the game, which can help you do more fancy shots!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/acbece99d754a8d67c681ae665ce8fb7764f4690.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png[/img]
[h2]How to use[/h2]
[*]To activate the masse shot, press Q twice to switch. In other words, there are now three shot poses, which can be switched by pressing Q.
[*]The masse shot stance can only be activated when the player is close to the cue ball and has a foothold. When the foothold is lost, it will automatically switch back to the normal stance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png[/img]
[h2]Some combat demonstrations[/h2]
[*]When both balls are close to the edge of the pool, but there is an obstacle ball in the middle, use the masse shot to hit the cue ball a little to the right below. The cue ball and make an arc to bypass the obstacle ball.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/82b19e0e876b2ca931179f9da414ae99c5a62b21.gif[/img]
[*]Using the masse shot stance, you can hit the center of the cue ball to make a higher jump shot to fly over the obstacle ball that the normal jump shot cannot fly over.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/1e7cf1bfe5a54feff19005041f31732b2f115348.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png[/img]

notes.title: Nine-Ball Roulette Now Support First Blood Mode!
notes.notes:
[h1]Let's see who has the worst luck[/h1]
Many players have complained to us that some players are very bored during the long wait after premature death, especially when playing with friends.
Now we have introduced a new game option: "First Blood Mode" (FB), in which the game ends as soon as one player is eliminated. And the murderer who eliminated the player will win the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png[/img]
[h1]Activation[/h1]
In the game lobby, the host can now activate "First Blood Mode" by lighting up the "FB" button on the left.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/c248da9b1d5fe1dc26567b0dd70a7d91f2427bb5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png[/img]
[h1]Winning Rules[/h1]
[*]If player A clears the table and causes player B to be eliminated, player A wins.
[*]If player B clears the table and causes a foul and die, the player above player B wins.
[*]If player B break-and-run but causes a foul and die, no player wins.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png[/img]
Thanks to all the friends for their support. If you have any suggestions or encounter any problems, you can give us feedback via wavebox66@gmail.com!

notes.title: "Nine-ball Roulette" Now Supports Jump Shot & Curve Shot
notes.notes:
[h2]Today, The Real Trick Shot King Is Back[/h2]
Just now, we added the "Lift the cue" feature to ourgame[i] [Shortcut: Q] [/i], in which you will be able to play a variety of trick shots.
The following are some actual combat demonstrations:
[list]
[*]Aim low to the right and use medium force to hit a jump shot, making the white ball jump slightly and still have a strong rotation when it lands.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/9025b08519758c1dadee352b952c781ffd70c984.gif[/img]
[*]Aim in the middle and use medium force to hit a regular jump ball, crossing the obstacle ball and hitting the target ball.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/98520d4d1f237fea108fde2a5a1717217b42aac4.gif[/img]
[*]Aim to the left and use small force to make a curve shot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/c48c578bbedf33cb697395b1f3eccc189f09cc34.gif[/img]
[*]You can even clear the table with one shot (this is a foul...)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/64979ec763028601c1c810424a47601e9c0331c5.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h2]Additional Rules[/h2]
[olist]
[*]A ball flies off the table is considered a foul, and the next player gets a ball-in-hand.
[*]If the 9 is no longer on the table when a foul occurs, the fouler loses and is punished.
[*]When the 9 is scored, if any other ball is out (e.g. the cue ball flies out of the table when the 9 is scored), the player will be deemed to have lost.
[/olist]
[b]It takes time to practice, then you become the king of trick shot![/b]
Thank you for your support. If you have any suggestions or encounter any problems, you can give us feedback via wavebox66@gmail.com!

notes.title: Optimized solutions to some known issues
notes.notes:
Recently we received some feedback. After testing, we found that these bugs can be optimized by players making some settings in the Steam client. Here we synchronize these methods to everyone.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png[/img]
[h2]Poor network & a series of problems caused by poor network[/h2]
Including but not limited to:
[olist]
[*]Unable to join the game.
[*]After the host exits the game, the game cannot be automatically continued.
[*]The ball cannot be spawned on the table (a non-existent ball is specified to be hit)
[/olist]
The solution is to open [b]Steam Settings-In-Game-Steam Networking-Allow games to share my IP[/b] and set it to always.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png[/img]
[h2]The microphone has no sound[/h2]
"Nine-Ball Roulette" uses the Steam default recording device. If there is no way to receive sound, you can debug it through [b]Steam Settings-Voice[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png[/img]
The above are some solutions we have collected and tested so far. If you have more solutions, please give us feedback via wavebox66@gmail.com

notes.title: [2025-01-19]Gameplay Update - Optimized billiard ball physics
notes.notes:
Just now, we made some updates to the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png[/img]
The content of this gameplay update is:
[list]
[*]High poles will be stronger and easier to hit the effect of sucking the library.
[*]When the middle pole hits the cue ball, it will be more in line with the real physical effect after directly colliding with the target ball.
[*]Fixed the bug that the game would freeze when the host disconnected in some cases.
[*]Optimized the perspective of hitting the ball, and now you can see more content when looking down.
[*]Optimized the logic of swinging the ball and fixed the bug that there was only the cue ball on the table in some cases.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png[/img]
Thank you for your support. If you have any comments or suggestions, please contact us at wavebox66@gmail.com!

notes.title: Nine-Ball Roulette is now VAC-integrated!
notes.notes:
[h2]If you cheat, you will be banned! [/h2]
As the number of players increases, some players have encountered malicious players who use cheats, which seriously affects the game experience. Now, "Nine-Ball Roulette" has integrated VAC! The main content includes:
[olist]
[*]If your account has a VAC ban record on this game, you will not be able to play "Nine-Ball Roulette".
[*]In the game, if multiple players detect that your game data is abnormal, you will be marked as VAC.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png[/img]
[h2]Maintaining a good game environment starts with you and me! [/h2]
Thanks to all the friends for their support, we will be committed to maintaining the game ecology of "Nine-Ball Roulette".
If you have any suggestions, please feel free to give us feedback at wavebox66@gmail.com !

notes.title: [2025-01-16#1]Gameplay update - Added friends feature
notes.notes:
Just now, we have added some new features to the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png[/img]
The content of this gameplay update is:
[list]
[*]Newly added friends function, click on the sitting player model in the room to jump to the player's profile page.
[*]Slightly reduce the friction of the table surface, so that the ball can roll farther under the same force.
[*]Optimize the first-person perspective display.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze when a player entered the room at the beginning of the game.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the screen to go black for a moment after placing a free ball.
[/list]

notes.title: "Nine-Ball Roulette" is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/3586b08e74331a6ef6d7e632d59f467c01278689.png[/img]
Our game "Nine-Ball Roulette" is officially released, with a 20% discount during the first week! Grab your buddies and join the fun!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png[/img]

[h1]About "Nine-Ball Roulette"[/h1]
This is the most thrilling billiards game you'll ever play. Join up to 3 of your friends in this intense and exciting roulette-style billiards match! Eliminate each other through billiards until only one remains standing.

The current version of the game supports the following modes:
[olist]
[*]Nine-Ball Mode
[*]Six-Ball Mode
[*]Four-Ball Mode(best for beginner)
[/olist]

The game also now supports single-player practice.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png[/img]

[h1]More Discounts[/h1]
"Nine-Ball Roulette" is now part of the WaveBox Labs Complete Bundle, with an additional 15% off!
The WaveBox Labs Complete Bundle also includes our previous game "Soccer in a Box," another highly entertaining multiplayer online game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png[/img]

[h1]Other[/h1]
A huge thanks to all the players who participated in the testing phase! Your involvement made our game more stable and enjoyable. We will continue to optimize the game based on player feedback, and we welcome everyone to join the Early Access journey!

If you encounter any issues while playing, feel free to reach out to us at wavebox66@gmail.com.

notes.title: "Nine-Ball Roulette" will be released on January 14!
notes.notes:
[h2]Our game "Nine-Ball Roulette" will be released on January 14, 2025![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png[/img]
In the current version of the game, you can experience:
[olist]
[*]Easy to learn. Even if you're not familiar with billiards, you can quickly get the hang of the game and immerse yourself in it.
[*]Stable game service. Thanks to our optimizations, you'll never again experience the frustrating situation where the host leaves the game and everyone loses.
[*]Achievement system. Record your brilliance in unique ways.
[*]Customizable rules. Whether it's 4-ball, 6-ball, or 9-ball, or even a time limit on shots.
[*]Ongoing updates. Your valuable feedback will help shape the future development of the game.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png[/img]

[h2]Early Access[/h2]
"Nine-Ball Roulette" is currently in Early Access, and future development will largely depend on player feedback. We also have some planned updates:
[olist]
[*]More types of table rules. Through testing, we've found that American pool tables are best suited for Nine-Ball Roulette rules, but other types of rules aren't out of the question. Let us know your thoughts—Chinese, Russian, or Snooker tables, or even carom tables?
[*]More appearance customization. Change your clothes, shoes, hats, and grab your unique cue stick to show off in-game.
[*]Item-based competitions. Who says you need a cue stick to play? (Alright, if you want to play like this, then go ahead!)
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45345206/eeae4c9f316aac27640dda5235bb374210f701d9.png[/img]

[h2]Thank you for your support, and we welcome you to continue following our game.[/h2]
Feel free to provide feedback via the community or through our email: wavebox66@gmail.com.
